## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of what problem this feature would solve.
Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternative Solutions
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Case
Describe the use case for this feature. How would it enhance the lending platform experience?

## Technical Implementation
If you have ideas on how to implement this feature, please share them here:
- Which component would be affected? (Frontend/Web/Both)
- Stacks integration changes needed
- UI modifications required
- Lending protocol impact

## Impact on Lending Platform
How would this feature affect:
- Lending/borrowing user flows
- Interest rate displays
- Asset management
- User onboarding

## Examples
Provide examples of similar features in other DeFi lending platforms.

## Additional Context
Add any mockups, references, or other relevant information.
